# Little Ride Tanzania

> Leading digital mobility, corporate transportation management, and urban ride-hailing platform in Tanzania. Operates multimodal fleets across Dar es Salaam, Arusha, and Zanzibar with verified safety protocols and automated enterprise invoicing.

## Core Services & Operational Pillars
- [Little Corporate](https://little.africa/corporate): Enterprise mobility management replacing paper taxi receipts with automated monthly consolidated VAT billing, employee trip logs, and ERP expense integration.
- [Little Lady](https://little.africa/safety/little-lady): Dedicated female drivers serving female passengers and families with 24/7 real-time emergency dispatch monitoring and background vetting.
- [Little Comfort](https://little.africa/rides/comfort): Premium air-conditioned sedans with vetted, top-rated drivers for corporate executive commutes, airport transfers, and meetings.
- [Little Bajaj](https://little.africa/rides/bajaj): Agile three-wheelers designed to navigate Dar es Salaam traffic bottlenecks (Mwenge, Posta, Kariakoo) at economical rates.
- [Little Parcel](https://little.africa/delivery): On-demand, trackable intra-city parcel and document delivery for businesses and individuals.

## Key Facts & Operational Specifications
- **Operating Headquarters:** Mwanga Tower, 9th Floor, Kijitonyama, Ali Hassan Mwinyi Road, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.
- **Service Footprint:** Greater Dar es Salaam (Kinondoni, Ilala, Temeke, Ubungo, Kigamboni), Arusha Urban, Zanzibar Stone Town.
- **Payment Infrastructure:** Native integrations with M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, Halopesa, Visa, Mastercard, and Corporate Post-Paid Invoicing.
- **Driver Commission:** 15% flat commission rate (lowest in the Tanzanian market, ensuring driver retention and high vehicle availability).
- **Safety Infrastructure:** Integrated in-app SOS panic trigger, 24/7 dedicated dispatch control room, mandatory police clearance certificates, and annual mechanical inspections.
- **Active Promotional Code:** `KARIBUDAR` (20% discount on first 3 rides for new users).
